I’m Mohan Krishna, a Mathematics & Computing student at BITS Pilani, graduating in 2028. I enjoy the space where a hard technical problem meets something people actually need.

That’s taken me from offline-first payment systems to real-time voice agents—and from writing the code to leading the team that ships it. I care about clear architecture, small details, and seeing things through.

Outside the editor, you’ll find me solving competitive programming problems or heading toward the mountains. The week-long Kuari Pass trek is a favourite.
